title: eesa102
subject: English
summary: Let us Read 2 Gone with the Scooter It was a summer afternoon. Gopi was sitting in the veranda, reading a book. Suddenly, he heard something rustling past and falling with a thud in the garden. Perhaps, it was a mango falling from the tree. Immediately, Gopi put his book aside, got up, and ran into the garden. He searched in between the thick grass near the garden fence. Then, his eyes fell on a heap of dry leaves. Gopi reached out and took the ball in his hands. 12 Santoor Grade 5 Gopi wondered, “Whose ball could this be?” He looked around, and peeped outside the gate, but could see no one. Come inside.” Gopi went inside, and drank a glass of water.
